title: Subscriber Ready
description: Formal evidence-based release gate. Passing automated tests alone is never sufficient. Verdicts: NOT READY | CONDITIONALLY READY | SUBSCRIBER READY.
principles: Never treat unexplained sample/demo content as finished product
No unreadable text or HTML leakage
No ignored console/network failures on primary journeys
No poor-value features presented as ready
Commercial reviewer asks: paid today — cancel/refund/trust loss?
Red Team independently disproves readiness — never rubber-stamps QA

criteria.title: Board blocker posture (P0–P2 / repair queue)
criteria.description: Open P0–P1 or repair queue → NOT READY. Open P2 → blocks SUBSCRIBER READY.

criteria.title: Platform foundation suite
criteria.description: Core automated regression for shared platform.

criteria.title: Production link / route validation
criteria.description: Broken local refs and critical public pages.

criteria.title: Production build verification
criteria.description: Build/deploy integrity checks.

criteria.title: Production-first inspection (URL + build + workflows)
criteria.description: Final SUBSCRIBER READY cannot be local-only. Campaign remap required for map/geo.

criteria.title: Browser smoke (console/network journeys)
criteria.description: Optional in constrained environments; required before claiming full browser readiness. Needs local server + ws.

criteria.title: Screenshot-first visual analysis (required viewports)
criteria.description: Generating screenshots ≠ review. Must analyze 375/430/tablet/laptop/1440/1728 with explicit observations.

criteria.title: Dynamic visual review (marker stability over time)
criteria.description: Observe geo/map state over time; assert no duplicate user markers; stable input → stable representation.

criteria.title: Accessibility smoke
criteria.description: Optional until live-site-qa Playwright deps installed; still required before full a11y SUBSCRIBER READY.

criteria.title: Sample/demo/placeholder detection
criteria.description: Fake/sample presented as real fails the gate.

criteria.title: Raw HTML / unreadable text leakage
criteria.description: Visible undefined/null/HTML entity leaks.

criteria.title: Dead control heuristics
criteria.description: Primary CTAs that go nowhere.

criteria.title: Responsive viewport basics
criteria.description: Primary HTML surfaces need viewport meta.

criteria.title: Privacy surface present
criteria.description: privacy.html must exist.

criteria.title: Loading / empty / error honesty
criteria.description: Requires honest-data attestation — not auto-covered.

criteria.title: Mobile / tablet / desktop
criteria.description: Requires screenshot-analysis evidence + visual attestation — not auto-covered.

criteria.title: Contrast + keyboard
criteria.description: A11y attestation dimension — not auto-covered.

criteria.title: Network / performance / security
criteria.description: Covered by production checks + security attestation — not auto-covered.

criteria.title: Content quality / visual consistency / discoverability / onboarding / persistence
criteria.description: Product + UX attestations with screenshot analysis — not auto-covered.

criteria.title: No fake functionality / placeholders-as-finished
criteria.description: Product Director + Commercial/Subscriber attestation.

criteria.title: Primary subscriber workflows complete
criteria.description: QA + Product Director attestation for the scoped campaign.

criteria.title: Live / estimate / placeholder honesty
criteria.description: Data/Reliability attestation.

criteria.title: Visual review pass for scoped surface
criteria.description: UX/UI Lead attestation with screenshot_analysis + dynamic_visual evidenceRefs; failures route to repair.

criteria.title: Commercial reviewer — cancel/refund/trust test
criteria.description: Independent commercial attestation + commercial visual gate (pricing support + finished vs prototype).

criteria.title: Red Team independent disproof pass
criteria.description: Red Team must attempt to disprove readiness; must not auto-accept engineering/QA.
